name: coder sandbox runner

CODER_SANDBOX_SECRET.description: Same value as CODER_CODESPACES_RUNNER_SECRET on the site

postStartCommand: nohup env RUNNER_MODE=local RUNNER_HOST=0.0.0.0 RUNNER_PORT=8790 RUNNER_MAX_BOXES=1 RUNNER_MIN_FREE_MB=0 RUNNER_SECRET="$CODER_SANDBOX_SECRET" node runner.mjs > /tmp/runner.log 2>&1 & (gh codespace ports visibility 8790:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)
